steps.title: Analyze Tapping Feedback Architecture
steps.description: Assess the existing multi-channel tap counter and its integrated audio synthesizer system for seamless combo addition.

steps.title: Design Arpeggiator Semitone Formula
steps.description: Develop a standard major-scale musical transposition mapping to convert click counts into pitch frequency multipliers.

steps.title: Introduce Combo Counter States
steps.description: Add fields for tracking combo streaks, automated timeouts, and arpeggiator resets within the MainActivity class.

steps.title: Extend User Interface layout XML
steps.description: Integrate the combo_multiplier_badge TextView inside the central tapping layout of activity_main.xml and add the new continuous BPM seekbar controller.

steps.title: Bind Combo Badging Components
steps.description: Lookup and reference the newly integrated combo multiplier badge view and the continuous BPM seekbar during the activity onCreate lifecycle phase.

steps.title: Create Metronome Inactivity Timer
steps.description: Incorporate a 1500ms handler reset callback that resets the arpeggiator pitch shift upon tapping cessation.

steps.title: Wire Pitch Multiplication Cascade
steps.description: Modify the central getBasePitchFrequency method to apply dynamic mathematical arpeggiator multiplier parameters.

steps.title: Integrate Tap Combo Updates
steps.description: Increment current combo chains on manual user touch inputs, trigger scale-up animations, and push telemetry logs.

steps.title: Enable Bubble Pop Combos
steps.description: Feed float bubble pop events into the arpeggiation system, allowing rapid bubble bursts to accelerate pitch sweeps.

steps.title: Style Combo Indicator Badges
steps.description: Harmonize the badge text color inside the applyTheme execution path to transition cleanly alongside ambient neon gradients, and apply active theme tints to the BPM seekbar dynamically.

steps.title: Perform Strict Compilation Audits
steps.description: Verify code uses traditional anonymous classes, avoiding lambda expressions for strict compliance with compilation environments.

steps.title: Building Simple Tap Counter
steps.description: Compile the modified resources, build scripts, and multi-channel code to output high-performance debug assets.
